facts.title: loss of containment at PSV-7102 during an intrusive maintenance task

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices on PSV-7102 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems on PSV-7102 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy on PSV-7102 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in inspecting pressure equipment, specifically performing in-service and hydrostatic inspection. PSV-7102 (tank relief and vent devices) is in service for tank overpressure and vacuum protection. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was not in place. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 29 November 2021 an incident occurred on PSV-7102 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during an intrusive maintenance task, releasing pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator.
